About the Project

The Leipzig School of Human Origins recruits doctoral researchers studying human evolution and related questions. Applicants should choose a research track and potential supervision that fits their academic preparation, then follow the School's call requirements. This PhD opening at Max Planck Society centres on Leipzig School of Human Origins PhD 2027. Disciplinary scope: Anthropology, Biology, Evolutionary Biology. The role is based in Leipzig, Germany. According to the listing, funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as Approx. €3,010/month gross (TV-L E13, 65% — typical doctoral level). Interested candidates should note the deadline: 30 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Human evolution
  • Anthropology
  • Evolutionary research

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://imprs.eva.mpg.de/about-us

Source: imprs.eva.mpg.de - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example
  • Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding

English language requirements

This structured German doctoral programme does not ask for IELTS or TOEFL scores at admission; the programme runs in English and proficiency is assessed through your written application, references and interviews. You can include a test score if you have one, but its absence does not weaken an application.
